blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: По ее милости я хожу раздет, живу в дешевом номере, ___ (питать / питаться) ерундой, пишу бледными чернилами.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Антон Чехов, «Моя «она»».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Она мешает мне читать, писать, гулять, ___ (наслаждаться / насладиться) природой…
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Моя «она»».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Во-вторых, она ___ (разорять) меня, как французская кокотка.
exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Моя «она»».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.
